description: This file defines a Backup class for handling backup and restore operations in the Notesnook project, including exporting, importing, migrating, and verifying backups, with support for encrypted and legacy formats.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Handles backup and restore operations, including exporting, importing, migration, and verification of backup data in various formats and versions.

methods.name: lastBackupTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last backup.

methods.name: updateBackupTime
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last backup to current time.

methods.name: exportLegacy
methods.description: Exports legacy backup data, supporting optional encryption.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports current backup data, supporting full or partial modes and encryption.

methods.name: backupCollection
methods.description: Streams and buffers collection items for backup, handling chunking.

methods.name: bufferToFile
methods.description: Converts buffered data into a backup file chunk, applying compression and encryption.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports backup data, handling decryption, decompression, and migration.

methods.name: migrateBackup
methods.description: Migrates backup data to current version, handling legacy formats.

methods.name: migrateData
methods.description: Migrates individual data items to current schema, handling attachment keys and item types.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates backup structure and essential fields.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies backup integrity via hash comparison.
